description: Every pdf op's output path: write to the plan's hidden temporary name, then claim the final name and move it there.

notes.text: Runs `write` against a temporary path and returns where the finished file or folder ended up.
The source's name without its extension, for the files a folder output holds.
Lets timers and I/O run between pages, so a cancel sent from outside gets through a long, mostly synchronous job.
